lines.text: Anything not fully specified gets /agentcraft:but-first-planning grill (one question at a time, each with a recommended answer) before it is planned or handed to a session you will not watch.

A plan lives in .agents/plan/, or in .agents/plans/<name>/ for one feature or task: a spec decision changes through /agentcraft:but-first-planning spec-edit, and an issue is built from its acceptance criteria as failing tests first (/agentcraft:but-first-planning build-tdd).
A published plan is worked through /agentcraft:agent-works orchestrate: its issues show on the board as cards.
